QuestInfo.name: Who's the Traitor?
QuestInfo.0: The impostor's plan seemed to involve driving #p2400005# and #p2400006# apart, but the fact that the Shadow Knights knew exactly where they were was far more troubling.
QuestInfo.1: With one of their own possibly working for the side of evil, they set about trying to find the traitor. The best clue would be something #rspider-shaped#k. They sped back to the temple to investigate.\r\n\r\n#r(Tip: Forfeit the quest if you need to restart.)#k
QuestInfo.2: None of the priests had any markings on themselves, but just as #p2400005# and #p2400006# were about to give up, they realized that #p2400008#'s #rdowsing ballast was marked with a spider#k! It could only mean one thing...
